svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of an Italian palazzo front: a rusticated ground floor and, above it, a roofed gallery of five arches on columns open to the air, through which the back wall and doors show behind a balustrade, with a round close-up of one bay. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
